## Specification

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  areset
 - input  in
 - output out

The module should implement a Moore machine with the diagram described
below:

  B (1) --0--> A
  B (1) --1--> B
  A (0) --0--> B
  A (0) --1--> A

It should asynchronously reset into state B if reset if high.

## Concrete scenario

Clock: `clk` (rising-edge). Each row is one clock cycle. Inputs are applied at the start of the cycle and held until the next cycle. `pre` = outputs just BEFORE the rising edge of that cycle; `post` = outputs just AFTER it.

| cycle | areset | in | A pre | A post | B pre | B post |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1'b1 | 1'b1 | - | out=1'b1 | - | out=1'b1 |
| 1 | 1'b1 | 1'b0 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b1 |
| 2 | 1'b0 | 1'b0 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b0 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b1 |
| 3 | 1'b0 | 1'b1 | out=1'b0 | out=1'b0 | out=1'b1 | out=1'b0 |

## Concrete scenario

| cycle | areset | in | pre | post |
